top3.headline: Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows $16.3B revenue and an $80.7B loss
top3.whyItMatters: Compute spend nearly quadrupled to $9B, so a key AI supplier's costs are now on the record.

top3.headline: Critical flaw in the Python Claude Agent SDK allows command execution
top3.whyItMatters: Teams running agents on the Python SDK should upgrade to 0.2.121 or later today.

top3.headline: Claude Code with Opus 5.5 tops a new coding agent index
top3.whyItMatters: The index scores model and harness together, the way your engineers actually use coding agents.

items.title: Benaich shares a talk on why research's last 20% stays slow
items.takeaway: Nathan Benaich shares a RAAIS talk by Alasdair Russell of Cambridge on why AI speeds research but leaves the last 20% as the bottleneck.
items.soWhat: Expect AI to speed the early work while the hardest finishing steps still set your timeline.

items.title: Meng To builds full landing pages with a budget model
items.takeaway: Meng To made several landing pages and a small 3D game with MiniMax M3.1 Flash, at $0.15 per 1M input tokens, and shared his prompts.
items.soWhat: Polished design work no longer requires frontier model prices.

items.title: Tavi Costa: the dollar did not catch its usual selloff bid
items.takeaway: Tavi Costa says the dollar's muted response during a selloff was the day's most important signal, while noting it is only one day.
items.soWhat: If the dollar stops acting as a haven, treasury and currency plans need a second look.

items.title: Grok Bot can now use Calendar, Reminders and Contacts on phones
items.takeaway: Grok Bot can now use Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and other phone apps, rolling out on iOS and Android, per Elon Musk and the Grok Bot account.
items.soWhat: Assistants are moving from chat windows into the apps where personal work actually happens.

related.name: poteto: use Grok Bot with native phone apps

items.title: Arc Institute uses AI agents to find new candidate RNAs
items.takeaway: An Arc Institute preprint uses genome language models and AI agents to find candidate functional RNAs in the genome's non-coding regions.
items.soWhat: Agents are starting to search scientific spaces too large for people to explore by hand.

items.title: Meta launches its Muse assistant in Japan
items.takeaway: Meta's Muse is now in Japanese app stores, and a $100,000 Open Kernel Challenge invites developers to make Muse Spark run fastest.
items.soWhat: Meta is expanding Muse country by country, adding another consumer assistant your customers may use.

related.name: The Verge: Meta turns Muse sharing back on

items.title: Claude Code with Opus 5.5 tops a new coding agent index
items.takeaway: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index v2.0 scores models with their agent harnesses over 290 tasks; Claude Code with Opus 5.5 leads at 61.7.
items.soWhat: Compare coding agents as model plus harness, since that pairing is what your teams actually run.

items.title: Perplexity's decision model now runs fully on a Mac
items.takeaway: Decider for Mac runs Perplexity's 4B decision model on device with no API key, returning a probability for questions about text or images.
items.soWhat: Small local models let teams automate yes-or-no calls without sending data to a vendor.

items.title: The Atlantic: PHP security rests on one volunteer
items.takeaway: The Atlantic profiles Ondřej Surý, a relatively anonymous volunteer working on PHP security.
items.soWhat: Check which critical open-source parts of your stack depend on a few unpaid people.

image.alt: The Atlantic: The Atlantic: PHP security rests on one volunteer

items.title: Phishing tuned for AI agents fools most email agents tested
items.takeaway: In the AgentPhishing benchmark, four of nine email agents detected under 10% of agent-optimized phishing and complied over 45% of the time.
items.soWhat: Any agent that reads your inbox needs controls beyond the model's own judgment.

image.alt: arXiv: Phishing tuned for AI agents fools most email agents tested

items.title: DoorDash agents clean stale feature flags for $4.79 each
items.takeaway: A DoorDash multi-agent system produced engineer-approved PRs for 45 of 50 stale flags, averaging $4.79 and 13.8 minutes per cleanup.
items.soWhat: Tedious engineering cleanup is now a measurable agent job with a clear cost per task.

image.alt: arXiv: DoorDash agents clean stale feature flags for $4.79 each

items.title: 35% of global work time is partly delegable to agents
items.takeaway: An index across 146 countries finds 35.2% of task time partly delegable to AI agents in 2026, and only 2.5% fully delegable.
items.soWhat: Plan for agents that share tasks with people, since full handoff remains rare.

items.title: Google Cloud gives every agent its own isolated microVM
items.takeaway: Google Cloud announced Agent Compute Engine, the microVM service behind Gemini agents, with per-agent identity and short-lived credentials.
items.soWhat: Isolated, per-agent sandboxes are becoming the default way to run agents safely at scale.

items.title: eMudhra exits the global TLS certificate business after a CA incident
items.takeaway: After an incident with its certificate authorities, eMudhra will leave global SSL/TLS, about 1% of its revenue; Go now distrusts the intermediates.
items.soWhat: A trust failure can end a vendor's product line, so know who issues your certificates.

items.title: Mistral ships Voxtral 3 speech models and a voice agent SDK
items.takeaway: Voxtral 3 covers speech-to-text in 50+ languages and text-to-speech in 35+, with a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK for Python and TypeScript.
items.soWhat: European teams get a voice agent stack they can run on an EU API or self-host.

items.title: Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows $16.3B revenue and an $80.7B loss
items.takeaway: Per the WSJ and Reuters, about $72B of Anthropic's first-half loss is a non-cash charge; compute spend rose to nearly $9B from $2.3B.
items.soWhat: A major AI supplier's costs and commitments are becoming public, which helps you judge its staying power.

image.alt: The Wall Street Journal: Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows $16.3B revenue and an $80.7B loss

items.title: Google releases a Gemini CLI built for other agents to call
items.takeaway: The Apache 2.0 gemini-api binary lets Codex, Claude Code or any shell agent call Gemini models, media tools and managed agents.
items.soWhat: Labs now package their APIs for agents first, so mixing vendors inside one workflow gets easier.

items.title: Critical flaw in the Python Claude Agent SDK allows command execution
items.takeaway: CVE-2026-96620 (CVSS 9.2): a crafted resume value could inject an MCP config and run arbitrary commands. Fixed in claude-agent-sdk 0.2.121.
items.soWhat: Upgrade any Python agents built on this SDK to 0.2.121 or later now.

voices.quote: The muted response of the dollar was arguably the most important thing today.
it shows how agents may be able to accelerate discovery in vast combinatoric spaces
AI can accelerate research and still leave the hardest part unfinished.
You can now run the Perplexity Decision Model fully locally on your Mac, without any data leaving your machine.
I made these landing pages with MiniMax M3.1 Flash, at a fraction of the cost of frontier models.
